items.title: Dan Wall and Adam Nussbaum interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 19, 2001
items.q: And that was a lot of fun. Sheila Jordan.

ctx.x: Yeah, “The Late Late Show.” And I had always loved her records and that was a lot of fun for me to be out doing gigs with her. She didn’t drive so a lot of times I would pick her up for the gig or take her back after the gig or something. But musically that was great, and there was another singer, Maxine Sullivan, who I did a record actually also with Maxine that got a lot of nice attention. And that was a lot of fun. Sheila Jordan. My wife is a singer, is a really good singer. We’ve enjoyed being able to work…

that vocalists, they block this whole concept out. “No I don’t want to work with a vocalist,” like it’s a waste of time. But with the right person it’s another zone. You can create incredible things but—
